conventions.model_id: Exact, case-sensitive Hugging Face repo id; the release node id is 'model::' + model_id.
conventions.space_id: Exact, case-sensitive Space repo id; the release node id is 'space::' + space_id.
conventions.github_repo_key: Lowercase 'owner/repo' key assigned by the archived extractor; the released node is 'https://github.com/' + github_repo_key. Not validated against GitHub.
conventions.provenance_ref: 'archive:<path relative to the archive root>#<record id>' or 'audit:<path relative to rq1_audit_2026Oct15>#<record id>'. data_row = 1-based data row after the CSV header; edges.rowid = SQLite rowid in table edges.

cohort_models.csv.grain: one row per cohort model (6,963 expected)

columns.base_rank: roots.csv rank for bases; blank for derivatives.
columns.parent_memberships: Number of cohort memberships with this derivative as child; blank for bases.
columns.graph_resolution_status: resolved (family-01 endpoint and in the 2026-08-28 model inventory) | in_family01_not_in_model_inventory | in_model_inventory_not_in_family01 | unresolved.

cohort_lineage.csv.grain: one row per original cohort membership (memberships.csv order; 6,821 expected); multi-parent derivatives keep one row per parent

columns.recorded_adaptation_label: Released family-01 edge_type: adapter | finetune | merged | quantized | new_version | converted.
columns.excluded_label: 1 if label is new_version or converted; such rows are admitted under no policy.
columns.lineage_evidence: model_lineage_edges_merged.csv evidence (declared_parent or the inference/weak-field rule).
columns.evidence_rule_id: Raw canonical label basis: explicit | tag_heuristic | field_implied | default | inferred:<rule>.
columns.label_basis: RQ2 collapsed basis (rq_policy.basis_label): explicit | tag_implied | field_implied | default | inferred.
columns.strict_admitted: RQ2 Strict: basis explicit, label not excluded.
columns.intermediate_admitted: RQ2 Intermediate: compute_canonical.in_intermediate, declared, label not excluded.
columns.declared_admitted: RQ2 Declared: declared parent, label not excluded.
columns.declared_provenance_ref: Row in declared_provenance.csv (blank for non-declared rows).

model_space_edges.csv.grain: one row per released family-12 edge whose model is in the cohort
model_space_edges.csv.semantics: used_by_space: the Space's Hugging Face API 'models' list names the model. A recorded association, not proof of runtime deployment.

columns.provenance_status: archived_evidence_row | release_build_api_fetch_no_archived_row (edge added by the release builder's live space_info(expand=models) fetch for Spaces present in card metadata but absent from relationship metadata; no archived evidence row exists).
columns.resolution_status: resolved_space_card_inventory (Space in the 2026-09-24 Space card inventory) | space_not_in_card_inventory.
columns.provenance_ref: Archived evidence row, or the builder function for API-fetch edges.

space_github_edges.csv.grain: one row per released family-14 edge whose Space appears in model_space_edges.csv
space_github_edges.csv.semantics: links_to_github: a GitHub repository referenced in the Space README. A recorded association, not a verified software dependency. Distinct from model_github_edges.

columns.evidence_channel: Archived evidence prefix, verbatim: model_card_markdown. For Space edges this prefix is a label reused from the model extractor; the actual origin is the Space README (see evidence_actual_origin).
columns.evidence_form: markdown_link | embedded_url (derived from the archived evidence; anchor text not exported).
columns.evidence_actual_origin: Snapshot the reference was extracted from.
columns.resolution_status: extracted_unvalidated: syntactically extracted, never checked against GitHub.

model_github_edges.csv.grain: one row per released family-10 edge whose model is in the cohort
model_github_edges.csv.semantics: links_to_github: a GitHub repository referenced in the model card README. Does not imply any Space uses that repository.

columns.evidence_actual_origin: Snapshot the reference was extracted from.
